headline: Marcos Administration Proposes ₱197.3 Billion for Rail Transport in 2027
seoTitle: ₱197.3B Rail Budget Proposed for 2027 | FMB News
seoDescription: The proposed 2027 budget allocates ₱197.3 billion to rail transport, with nearly 97 percent for the NSCR and Metro Manila Subway.
deck: The proposal would more than triple 2026 rail funding and concentrate most of the allocation on the North-South Commuter Railway and Metro Manila Subway.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Marcos administration proposed ₱197.3 billion for the rail transport program under the 2027 National Expenditure Program, more than triple the amount provided under the 2026 General Appropriations Act.

sections.heading: Largest allocations
paragraphs: About ₱191.28 billion, nearly 97 percent of the proposed rail budget, is earmarked for two flagship projects: ₱123.84 billion for the North-South Commuter Railway and ₱67.44 billion for Phase I of the Metro Manila Subway.

sections.heading: Other projects
paragraphs: The proposal also includes funding for the LRT-1 Cavite Extension, MRT-3 rehabilitation and interim operations related to the common-station connection among major rail lines.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: The amount is an executive budget proposal and remains subject to congressional scrutiny, amendment and approval.
